method: Fixed frame normalization; circle edges locate eroded disc samples only. Shared RGB target from even UUIDs; odd UUIDs validate. Two intensity clusters reject ink. No geometry or per-scan color adjustment.
targetBinding: Correct measured-source attenuation against the actual released palette; round RGB bytes before raster validation.

redGlyph.policy: Normalized ink bounds, three relative-contrast thresholds. Choose on even UUIDs; report odd UUIDs without tuning. 24px nominal disc for expansion units.
